description: Sarah and Adam swap caravan life for their dream home in rural Cornwall.

title: Impossible Builds
description: Jamie Feilden's 60-acre farm doubles as a charity for urban youth. To fund it, he now plans two prefabricated elliptical cabins on a remote slope. They'll feature timber decks, open-plan living, and green roofs—though weather may delay the build.

title: Impossible Builds
description: Delaval and Veronica are restoring 450 acres for conservation and funding it by building a treehouse in Swanton Novers Wood. A Scottish firm constructs it in 7 sections to minimize damage to the woodland habitat on delivery.

description: Paul and Trent want to escape their busy lives to a 600-acre conservation property.
